description: Remove student login functionality completely while keeping admin authentication intact. Transform system to allow guest bookings where students can book rooms without creating accounts or logging in.
goal: Students book rooms directly at /book URL by filling a student details form, while administrators retain full login functionality for managing bookings.

currentState.problem: Students must register accounts and login before booking study rooms
currentState.flow: Student visits site → Login Page → Enter credentials → Authenticate → Dashboard → Book Room
currentState.affectedUsers: All students need authentication before booking

targetState.solution: Students can book without login, admin authentication preserved
targetState.flow: Student visits /book → Fill details form → Select room/time → Book room (No login required)
targetState.affectedUsers: Students: No login needed. Admins: Must login as before

finalResult: A fully functional guest booking system where students can book rooms immediately without authentication, while admin dashboard remains unchanged with full authentication requirements.

benefits: Reduced friction: 4 clicks reduced to 2 clicks for students

complexity.riskLevel: Medium - Well planned with rollback strategy

mustHave: Guest student data collected in form
Booking submission works with guest data

keyDecisions: Update API to accept guest data
